purpose: Confirm functional recovery benefit on new intervention operands with all masks frozen
dataset_revision: CCAD original deterministic paired addition development panel v1
budget: One existing RTX5070Ti via gpu-0;1200driver seconds, expected~500s from prior~.0061s/padded generation. No fitting, model/SAE training or new assets.
templates:
Q: What is 12 plus 23? A: 35
Q: What is 34 plus 12? A: 46
Q: What is {a} plus {b}? A:
scope: Confirmation on128distinct recipient-donor pairs built from256operand questions never used in prior intervention development, each rendered in the same two prompt forms. Their unedited base answers were previously observed; their edited outcomes were not. Operand split, task family, model, five dependent SAE cycles and fitted masks are fixed. New question identities are disjoint from prior recipient/donor operands. Two coprimary contrasts at64target updates compare clean relation initialization against Fisher-contrast and selected-member assignment in full hybrid accuracy averaged equally over units/tens and prompt forms. Report both paired95percent bootstrap intervals over operand-pair clusters, conditional on the fixed five-SAE network; claim a confirmed mean benefit only if both lower bounds exceed zero.16updates and per-digit/preservation results are prespecified secondary. All outcomes retained, no refit or selection on this confirmation.
statistics_unit: Recipient-donor operand pair cluster, averaging the two prompt forms, two requests and five fixed target SAEs; no independent-seed or broader-task inference

confirmation.aggregation: equal mean over operations, prompt forms and target seeds within each operand pair
confirmation.decision: both lower bounds strictly positive; fixed five-SAE network conditional inference
